prompts: Use case: stylized-concept. Create a BRAND NEW standalone raster animation asset inspired specifically by the attached Kamayuu homepage and actual card back, not a homepage redesign. Images are style/identity references. Kamayuu identity is an angular compass rose, crescent and tiny four-point star, etched aged brass, deep midnight sapphire and amber lantern lighting. ABSOLUTELY NO LOTUS, flowers, petals, crown, generic spinner, words or letters. Output one square genuinely TRANSPARENT-background orthographic front-facing asset: a richly sculpted gold four-point compass needle at the center, a tiny black enamel circular pivot with a gold four-point sparkle; the long north/south points angular and sharp just like the homepage mark, sidepoints shorter. Center needle extent no more than 53% of full canvas width and height. Surround it with a completely detached delicate double brass astrolabe ring whose INNER diameter is 68% of canvas and OUTER diameter is 83%; there must be a clear transparent annular gap between needle and ring so I can rotate the parts separately. Ring has minute engraved ticks, asymmetrical tiny celestial notches and four small diamonds, aged gold edges, midnight enamel inlays, editorial luxury not generic casino. No lettering around ring. Clean silhouette, no glow/shadow outside metal. Transparent margins all sides. Extremely polished dimensional game artwork at 1024 square, cinematic warm edge lighting, restrained realistic patina matching the references. Exactly one centered assembled compass device, no additional objects.

Use case: stylized-concept. Create a BRAND NEW raster animation source based specifically on the attached current Kamayuu homepage and actual sapphire-and-gold crescent/compass card-back. Reference-only, do not redraw the homepage. Output ONE isolated playing card standing straight in orthographic front view, no perspective; portrait ratio 0.71 width to height, occupying 58% canvas width and 82% canvas height on a square genuinely TRANSPARENT canvas. Exact brand vocabulary: midnight sapphire embossed leather, gold engraved rectangular border with clipped ornamental corners, luminous crescent moon embracing a four-point star inside a fine angular eight-point compass rose. Slender gold orbit lines and four corner diamonds. The central crescent and star must be clearly readable at 90px card height. Gold aged/brushed brass like the homepage compass, warm lantern-lit bevel edges, blue almost black shadows, intricate premium materials, coherent geometric filigree. No lotus, no flower/petals, no crown, no text, no letters, no numbers, no fake text, no extra cards, no background, no drop shadow, no green. Strong solid silhouette suitable for smooth flipping and card-cut animation. Generous transparent margins; perfectly centered and undistorted.
